{{Quote|Our shipboard rations have fallen somewhat below the levels outlined in code eighteen, and the Quartermaster Corps restocking estimate is currently nine weeks.|Elara Dorne|<ref name="Regulatory Decisions">{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Elara Dorne]]|Regulatory Decisions}}</ref>}}
The '''Quartermaster Corps''' was a division of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] that was responsible for issuing supplies and rations to the personnel of the military.<ref name="Regulatory Decisions" /> The Quartermaster Corps posted high-ranking [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply officers]] to field and front-line positions to better interact with their direct subordinates. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply]] command took inspiration from the program for its own [[drop point]] system of forward supply caches.<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
